cases.utterance: how many GitHub issues are open versus closed?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT state, COUNT(*) AS issue_count FROM github_issues GROUP BY state ORDER BY issue_count DESC

cases.utterance: how many issues are there for each label?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT labels, COUNT(*) AS issue_count FROM github_issues GROUP BY labels ORDER BY issue_count DESC

cases.utterance: how many issues has each author opened?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT author, COUNT(*) AS issue_count FROM github_issues GROUP BY author ORDER BY issue_count DESC
